 As an intern, you’ll work alongside our experienced practitioners and with our clients and communities. This hands-on experience will equip you with practical skills, build your network, and provide opportunities that set you up for success.
 As energy availability becomes increasingly critical, there’s no end to the scope and significance of your work — and to where it can take you at Stantec. Every day, we’re problem-solving and collaborating on projects that are as challenging as they are impactful. Whether designing new EV charging or CNG delivery systems, a transformational cross-country pipeline, optimizing facilities, verifying the safety and reliability of an asset, or in the field overseeing construction projects, you’ll be joining a team of recognized industry experts on work that’s critical to our clients and our communities. The Energy industry is changing — and we’re helping clients stay ahead of the change. Join a team that’s working together with industry to deliver innovation for the long term on some of the most important and interesting projects around the world.

GHD is currently seeking an Intern to work with our groups on projects related to Environment, Transportation, Water, Architecture, and Construction Inspection services. This position is a paid internship position. Our teams work with a wide range of public and private sector clients across Ontario to support sustainable infrastructure, environmental stewardship, and community development. 
 The objective of GHD’s Internship Program is to provide students who self-identify as members of Indigenous communities the opportunity to gain experience in a consulting environment and contribute to a range of infrastructure and environmental projects. The program is intended to provide meaningful professional experience, mentorship, and exposure to the types of work delivered by multidisciplinary consulting teams. 
 Working with an energetic and high‑performing team, this position offers a variety of work and will see you involved in : 
 Assisting with client, contractor, and internal communications, including preparation of reports, presentations and meeting records 
 Participating in project-related site visits and field work where appropriate to support project understanding and field activities 
 Conducting research related to projects 
 Preparing documentation, including funding applications, project progress and completion reports, and project memorandums 
 Providing support for project administrative tasks 
 Participating in design and project team meetings
